questions.q: Why is analog safer than a compressed digital system at the edge of range?
options: Analog has noticeably more range at the same power
The picture gets noisy but doesn't freeze
Analog isn't affected by obstacles and reflections
Analog has a higher frame rate at the edge
questions.explain: Analog degrades gracefully; digital holds a clean picture up to a threshold and then freezes or breaks up.

questions.q: Why do you have to measure a digital system's latency yourself?
options: Manufacturers don't specify it at all
It depends on the mode and link quality
It can't be measured without goggles with recording
It's the same for all systems of one class
questions.explain: The quoted figure is the minimum in the best mode; at the edge the bitrate and frame rate drop and latency grows.

questions.q: Where do compression blocks show up first?
options: On a static scene while hovering in place
On a fast pass over grass
Flying into the sun at sunset
At low altitude over flat asphalt
questions.explain: Inter-frame compression works worst when neighboring frames are not alike — a fine, detailed scene in motion.

questions.q: How does the HD OSD get into the goggles of a digital system?
options: The flight controller overlays it on the video signal itself
Via MSP DisplayPort, the goggles draw it
The OSD reaches the goggles through the ELRS receiver
Through a separate video input on the air unit's camera
questions.explain: The flight controller sends what to draw; the rendering happens on the digital system's side.

questions.q: Which parameters enable HD OSD in ArduPilot?
options: SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 42 and OSD_TYPE = 5
SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 2 and OSD_TYPE = 1
OSD_TYPE = 3 and VTX_ENABLE = 1 together
SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 33 and OSD_TYPE = 2
questions.explain: Protocol 42 is DisplayPort on the port, OSD_TYPE 5 is MSP DisplayPort.

questions.q: What sets HDZero apart from compressed digital systems?
options: It's analog with a digital OSD on top
No inter-frame compression, stable latency
It only works in the 2.4 GHz band
It has the best sharpness of all systems
questions.explain: Frame-synchronous transmission without inter-frame compression: predictable latency at the cost of sharpness.

questions.q: Why would an autopilot aircraft use OpenIPC + WFB-ng?
options: It has the lowest latency of all systems
Openness and MAVLink in the same channel
It doesn't need antennas on the air unit
It works without any frequency rules
questions.explain: Open firmware and a telemetry tunnel; latency is higher than FPV systems, and you build it by hand.

questions.q: Analog and digital are flying at the field, and a neighbor has interference. First step?
options: Raise your VTX power to maximum
Coordinate channels, lower power
Switch to directional patch antennas
Turn off video recording in your goggles
questions.explain: Digital channels are wider; a frequency plan and power on the ground solve most conflicts.
